incidents.name: LW transferFrom from the token contract without allowance
incidents.notes: LW.transferFrom() accepts the token contract itself as the source without checking any allowance, so the attacker pulled 1e33 LW straight out of the contract and sold it into the LW/BUSDT pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xABC6e5a63689b8542dbDC4b4f39a7e00d4AC30c8 created 2024-07-07T06:33:35Z by 0xef200a2238c508dade54fbf6ced707368ff6fbe6, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x56b2d55457b31fb4b78ebddd6718ea2667804a06; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
